title: Find student housing in Leiden

shortSummary.text: Check the university route and search independently; a request never guarantees a room.

whoThisIsFor.text: International students preparing to study in Leiden.

whenYouNeedIt.text: Start early, before travelling or making irreversible arrangements.

jurisdiction.note: National rules; local starting points for Leiden students.

prerequisites.text: Start early, before travelling or making irreversible arrangements.

requiredDocuments.text: Ask the verified provider for its application requirements. Municipal registration has a separate document list.

estimatedTime.note: There is no guaranteed search or allocation time.

estimatedCost.note: The university lists a €285 housing fee, separate from rent and other charges. Check current terms before paying.

numberedSteps.title: Check the intake
numberedSteps.body: On 11 November 2026, Spring 2027 degree housing was closed; exchange/study-abroad applications remained open. Recheck the live notice.

numberedSteps.title: Broaden the search
numberedSteps.body: Compare ROOM and surrounding towns using the university’s independent-search page. Check travel and total monthly costs.

numberedSteps.title: Verify before paying
numberedSteps.body: Verify the advertiser and property. Inspect the contract and registration arrangements; avoid sending identity documents to an unknown advertiser.

warnings.text: Paying the housing fee does not guarantee accommodation.

commonMistakes.text: Do not confuse the advertised rent with the complete monthly bill.

tips.text: Once you know your address, prepare municipal registration.

faqs.question: University housing full?
faqs.answer: Use the independent-search route; do not assume a waiting-list place will become a room.

faqs.question: Live outside Leiden?
faqs.answer: Consider nearby towns and check the commute before agreeing.

faqs.question: Registration unclear?
faqs.answer: Ask the municipality about your real residential address. Registration alone does not legalise occupation.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: If housing remains unresolved, discuss options with the university before travelling.
